races.notes: Top-four primary, ranked-choice general; if no one passes 50% of first choices, the tabulation runs later, so the call may come days after election night. TWO CANDIDATES SURNAMED SULLIVAN: incumbent Sen. Dan S. Sullivan (R; ballot 'Sullivan, Dan S.', Ballotpedia 'Daniel S. Sullivan') and retired teacher Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. The surname filter cannot tell them apart; the detector must match the full name/incumbent. Party of Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. is null on purpose: Ballotpedia and NBC (1 Sep) list him as Republican, but CBS reports the sample ballot shows him with no party affiliation. DOJ has asked Alaska to segregate ballots ranking him, and the governor has ordered an investigation (late Oct 2026), so his ballot status may be litigated. Gerald Heikes (R) advanced after Democrat David Leslie withdrew. Most polls close 8pm AKST (midnight ET); the Aleutians west of 169.5W close 8pm HAST (1am ET Wed 4 Nov), which is the value used. Media treat the state as callable from midnight ET.
